about_text: NovoTech's premium-line pipe benders and welding positioners are built in Turkey to our specification. The TB 34 and TB 42 are simple mandrel-less pipe benders with a digital angle readout and a brake motor that holds the bend, and the WP 100 and WP 300 tilting welding positioners turn round parts under the torch at 1 – 5.5 rpm, foot-pedal controlled.

NovoTech sells, installs and supports its premium-line pipe benders and welding positioners in Canada from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada — dies chosen for your parts, installation, operator training, a CSA-approved panel on three-phase machines, a 1-year warranty and parts and technical support in Canada.
